text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, <chrname> and the
other
students have gone on a field trip
to observe a
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The academy is void of students and
completely
silent... or so I thought... I
hear faint groaning
sounds from nearby.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Urghhh... Gurrrggh! Where have my
precious
Umas gone?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's right... I'm Agnes Zombie Digital,
and I'm
starving for Umas!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Poor wittle me! I've been out sick with a
cold for
the past few days...
choice_data_list: 生徒はレース見学に行ったはずじゃ……
choice_data_list_en: Weren't the students supposed to be watching the race...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But I forcibly expelled that plague from
my
system because I was craving a
sweet, sweet
glimpse of some glorious
Umas!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But what's this?! There's not even a
WHIFF of an
Uma around! I can't believe
I forgot there was a
field trip today!
Curses! What a fool I am!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Guehehehe... Yeees, you are so
right. It's
not like I'll be able to find any
sustenance at the
academy anyway...
choice_data_list: 大事をとって帰ったら？
今からでも参加できるはず！
choice_data_list_en: Why don't you head home, just to be safe?
You should still be able to join in!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second! You! Got any top-tier
insider
stories about the Uma you're
partnered with?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I worked so hard to drag myself out
here! The
least you could do is bless me
with some good
stuff! Nourish my poor,
shriveled-up heart!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it's "top-tier" or anything,
but I tell
her a story about what
happened to
<chrname>
during training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Ohoho... Thank you for the food... I'm calling it quits today, but I'll come back tomorrow to worship my lovely Umas!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
ASDFSLKSF?! Are you some kind of
god?! What
are we waiting for?! Let's go
now! To the paradise
of my dreeeaaams!
choice_data_list: 遅刻手続きをすれば大丈夫
choice_data_list_en: You'll be fine as long as you fill out a tardy slip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can calm down Agnes
Digital
when she's like this, so I help
complete her
late-arrival paperwork and
take her to the venue.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Can you blame me?! Even if the
members and
venue are the same, no
two shows are exactly
alike! Besides...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The feelings that your oshi gives you are
on a
completely different level! It's why
otaku literally
go to every performance
they can!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, my journey continues! I must
seek out
the best spot I can in order to
worship my favorite
Uma with my whole
heart!
